title: Some coordinate projection is injective on a given n-plane
statement: For all N, n ∈ ℕ and every linear subspace L ⊆ ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with dim L = n, there is a set J ⊆ Fin N with exactly n elements such that coordinateProjection J is injective on L. Here coordinateProjection J is the orthogonal projection of ℝᴺ onto span{e_j : j ∈ J}.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ L = n → ∃ J : Finset (Fin N), J.card = n ∧ Set.InjOn (coordinateProjection J) (L : Set (Rn N))
